translationRepairs: Its soil soil; lower soil loam.
Its soil was soft loam; the lower soil was fertile clay.

其土壤，下土墳壚 is broken as “Its soil soil,” and the proposal’s “Its soil was soil” still fails to render 壤 as a soil grade. 壤 is soft/loamy earth and 墳壚 the richer lower clay, so both halves need that quality wording.
After the Four Peaks recommend Yu, 舜曰：「嗟，然！」is approving assent (matching the following charge to Yu), not lament; “Alas” misreads 嗟, and “Ah—yes!” restores the approving interjection.
Yu said, "I marry Tushan on xinren, guijia, bore Qi I not treat as son, thereby able complete earth-water merit.
Yu said, "I married a woman of Tushan on the days xin and ren; on gui and jia Qi was born, and I did not treat him as a son, and thereby could complete the earth-and-water works."

The before text is ungrammatical and the xin-ren / gui-jia sequence plus 予不子 must be repaired, but the proposal’s “married at Tushan” turns 娶涂山 into a wedding place, and the bracketed “[doting]” / “[Qi]” glosses invent tone not in the literal. Keep the day-pair reading and render 娶涂山 as marrying a woman of Tushan, 生啟 as Qi’s birth, and 予不子 as not treating him as a son.
Kongjia granted him the surname Dragon-tamer and received the Shiwei as his fief.
Kongjia granted him the surname Dragon-tamer, and he received the succession of the Shiwei.
In 孔甲賜之姓曰御龍氏，受豕韋之後 the implied subject of 受 is Liu Lei (之), who receives the Shiwei line’s succession; the before text wrongly makes Kongjia the one who “received the Shiwei as his fief.”
Fa died and his son Lügui became the tyrant Jie.
Fa died and his son Lügui was established; this was Jie.
帝發崩，子帝履癸立，是為桀 only records Fa’s death, Lügui’s accession, and the identification 是為桀; “tyrant” is not in the Chinese and invents a moral label the unit does not state.

units.zh: 夏禹，名曰文命。
units.en: Yu of Xia bore the name Wenming.
units.literal: Xia's Yu was called Wenming.

units.zh: 禹之父曰鯀，鯀之父曰帝顓頊，顓頊之父曰昌意，昌意之父曰黃帝。
units.en: Yu's father was Gun; Gun's father was Emperor Zhuanxu; Zhuanxu's father was Changyi; Changyi's father was the Yellow Emperor.
units.literal: Yu's father was called Gun; Gun's father was called Emperor Zhuanxu; Zhuanxu's father was called Changyi; Changyi's father was the Yellow Emperor.

units.zh: 禹者，黃帝之玄孫而帝顓頊之孫也。
units.en: Yu was a great-great-grandson of the Yellow Emperor and a grandson of Emperor Zhuanxu.
units.literal: Yu was the Yellow Emperor's great-great-grandson and Emperor Zhuanxu's grandson.

units.zh: 禹之曾大父昌意及父鯀皆不得在帝位，為人臣。
units.en: Neither Yu's great-grandfather Changyi nor his father Gun ever held the throne; both served merely as ministers.
units.literal: Yu's great-grandfather Changyi and father Gun both did not attain the imperial throne; they were subjects.

units.zh: 當帝堯之時，鴻水滔天，浩浩懷山襄陵，下民其憂。
units.en: Under Emperor Yao the floodwaters rose to the sky, spread around the peaks, and overtopped the hills, and the people lived in dread of them.
units.literal: In Emperor Yao's time the vast flood swelled to heaven; vastly it embraced mountains and overflowed hills; the common people worried over it.

units.zh: 堯求能治水者，群臣四嶽皆曰鯀可。
units.en: Yao looked for someone who could manage the flood; the officials and the lords of the Four Peaks all said, "Gun may do it."
units.literal: Yao sought one able to regulate the waters; all the ministers and the Four Peaks said, "Gun can do it."

units.zh: 堯曰：「鯀為人負命毀族，不可。」
units.en: Yao replied, "Gun disobeys orders and harms his own people. I cannot use him."
units.literal: Yao said, "Gun as a man defies commands and ruins kin groups; not acceptable."

units.zh: 四嶽曰：「等之未有賢於鯀者，願帝試之。」
units.en: The Four Peaks answered, "No one in their ranks surpasses Gun; we ask you to give him a trial."
units.literal: The Four Peaks said, "Among their peers none is worthier than Gun; we beg the Emperor to try him."

units.zh: 於是堯聽四嶽，用鯀治水。
units.en: Yao yielded and put Gun in charge of the flood works.
units.literal: Thereupon Yao heeded the Four Peaks and employed Gun to regulate the waters.

units.zh: 九年而水不息，功用不成。
units.en: Nine years passed, the flood never relented, and the project failed.
units.literal: After nine years still the waters did not subside; the task was not completed.

units.zh: 於是帝堯乃求人，更得舜。
units.en: Emperor Yao began looking again and found Shun.
units.literal: Thereupon Emperor Yao then sought another man and obtained Shun in his stead.

units.zh: 舜登用，攝行天子之政，巡狩。
units.en: Shun was raised to high office, administered affairs in the Son of Heaven's name, and toured the realm.
units.literal: Shun was promoted and employed; he exercised the Son of Heaven's government in proxy and went on tours of inspection.

units.zh: 行視鯀之治水無狀，乃殛鯀於羽山以死。
units.en: On his rounds he saw that Gun had achieved nothing with the waters, so he had Gun executed on Mount Yu.
units.literal: On tour he observed Gun's regulation of the waters—no achievement—and then struck Gun dead on Mount Yu.

units.zh: 天下皆以舜之誅為是。
units.en: Throughout the realm people judged Shun's sentence just.
units.literal: All under Heaven considered Shun's punishment right.

units.zh: 於是舜舉鯀子禹，而使續鯀之業。
units.en: Shun then promoted Gun's son Yu to carry on his father's work.
units.literal: Thereupon Shun raised Gun's son Yu and had him continue Gun's task.

units.zh: 堯崩，帝舜問四嶽曰：「有能成美堯之事者使居官？」
units.en: When Yao died, Emperor Shun asked the Four Peaks, "Is there anyone who can complete Yao's work and take office?"
units.literal: Yao passed away; Emperor Shun asked the Four Peaks, saying, "Is there anyone who can complete Yao's work and be appointed to office?"

units.zh: 皆曰：「伯禹為司空，可成美堯之功。」
units.en: They said, "Lord Yu, as Minister of Works, could finish what Yao began."
units.literal: All said, "Lord Yu as Minister of Works can complete and beautify Yao's achievements."

units.zh: 舜曰：「嗟，然！」
units.en: Shun exclaimed, "Well said—it shall be so."
units.literal: Shun said, "Ah—yes!"

units.zh: 命禹：「女平水土，維是勉之。」
units.en: He ordered Yu: "You shall bring the land and waters to order; give it your whole strength."
units.literal: He charged Yu: "You—level the waters and earth; only this—exert yourself."

units.zh: 禹拜稽首，讓於契、后稷、皋陶。
units.en: Yu kowtowed and declined in favor of Xie, Hou Ji, and Gao Yao.
units.literal: Yu bowed touching head to ground and yielded to Xie, Prince Millet, and Gao Yao.

units.zh: 舜曰：「女其往視爾事矣。」
units.en: Shun told him, "Go and attend to your task."
units.literal: Shun said, "You—go and look to your affairs."

units.zh: 禹為人敏給克勤；
units.en: Yu was quick-witted, responsive, and tirelessly industrious.
units.literal: Yu as a person was quick, responsive, and able in diligence.

units.zh: 其德不違，其仁可親，其言可信；
units.en: He kept to the moral path, drew others with kindness, and spoke so that men could rely on him.
units.literal: His virtue did not deviate; his benevolence was approachable; his words were trustworthy.

units.zh: 聲為律，身為度，稱以出；
units.en: His voice matched the tuning tubes, his bearing matched the plumb line, and he carried himself with measured grace.
units.literal: His voice was a pitch-pipe; his body was a measure; proportion issued from them.

units.zh: 亹亹穆穆，為綱為紀。
units.en: Steadfast and grave, he set the pattern others followed.
units.literal: Earnest, earnest; solemn, solemn—he was warp and he was woof.

units.zh: 禹乃遂與益、后稷奉帝命，命諸侯百姓興人徒以傅土，行山表木，定高山大川。
units.en: Yu, with Yi and Hou Ji, carried out the Son of Heaven's orders, mobilized nobles and commoners to shift soil, blazed trails along ridges and marked timbers, and charted every major height and watercourse.
units.literal: Yu then together with Yi and Hou Ji received the Emperor's commands; he ordered the lords and commoners to raise work gangs to spread earth, marched along mountains marking trees, and fixed the high mountains and great rivers.

units.zh: 禹傷先人父鯀功之不成受誅，乃勞身焦思，居外十三年，過家門不敢入。
units.en: He mourned that Gun had died unfinished yet under sentence of death, so he drove himself until body and mind were spent, spent thirteen years away from home, and even passed his own door without stopping.
units.literal: Yu grieved that his forebear and father Gun had not completed the work and suffered execution; thereupon he wore out his body and burned his thoughts, dwelt outside thirteen years, passed his gate without daring to enter.

units.zh: 薄衣食，致孝于鬼神。
units.en: He lived plainly in dress and diet and showed the spirits the utmost reverence.
units.literal: He made thin his clothing and food; he extended filial devotion toward ghosts and spirits.

units.zh: 卑宮室，致費於溝淢。
units.en: He kept his halls modest and poured labor into drains and canals.
units.literal: He made low his palace chambers; he expended effort on ditches and channels.

units.zh: 陸行乘車，水行乘船，泥行乘橇，山行乘檋。
units.en: He traveled by carriage on dry ground, by boat on water, by sledge in mire, and by litter in the hills.
units.literal: On land he rode in a carriage; on water he rode in a boat; in mud he rode a sledge; in mountains he rode a palanquin.

units.zh: 左準繩，右規矩，載四時，以開九州，通九道，陂九澤，度九山。
units.en: Plumb line in his left hand, square in his right, he followed the seasons, opened the nine provinces, linked the nine highways, diked the nine marshes, and surveyed the nine ranges.
units.literal: Left the marking-cord and line, right the compass and square; he bore the four seasons to open the nine provinces, open the nine roads, bank the nine marshes, measure the nine mountains.

units.zh: 令益予眾庶稻，可種卑溼。
units.en: He told Yi to distribute rice seed for the people to sow in the wet lowlands.
units.literal: He ordered Yi to give the multitude rice, plantable in low damp places.

units.zh: 命后稷予眾庶難得之食。
units.en: He told Hou Ji to supply food where famine threatened.
units.literal: He ordered Prince Millet to give the multitude hard-to-obtain food.

units.zh: 食少，調有餘相給，以均諸侯。
units.en: Where supplies ran short, he moved surplus from one region to another so that no domain starved alone.
units.literal: When food was scarce, he adjusted surplus to mutual aid so as to equalize the lords.

units.zh: 禹乃行相地宜所有以貢，及山川之便利。
units.en: He then assessed what each region could yield in tribute and how mountains and rivers could serve transport.
units.literal: Yu then proceeded to survey each land for what it should offer as tribute and for the convenience of mountains and rivers.

units.zh: 禹行自冀州始。
units.en: Yu began his survey in Jizhou.
units.literal: Yu's progress began from Jizhou.

units.zh: 冀州：既載壺口，治梁及岐。
units.en: In Jizhou he finished work at Hukou and brought order to the Liang and Qi ranges.
units.literal: Jizhou: already loaded at Hukou, regulated Liang and Qi.

units.zh: 既脩太原，至于嶽陽。
units.en: He restored Taiyuan and continued south of Mount Yue.
units.literal: Already repaired Taiyuan, reaching the south of Mount Yue.

units.zh: 覃懷致功，至於衡漳。
units.en: He completed the Tanhuai basin and carried the work to the Heng and Zhang rivers.
units.literal: Tanhuai achieved merit, reaching Heng and Zhang.

units.zh: 其土白壤。
units.en: The soil was pale, loose earth.
units.literal: Its soil was white loam.

units.zh: 賦上上錯，田中中，常、衛既從，大陸既為。
units.en: Its tax was partly top grade and partly second grade; its fields were middling; the Chang and Wei had already been brought into order, and the great plain emerged.
units.literal: Some tax was top grade and some second grade; its fields were middling; the Chang and Wei were already in order, and the great plain emerged.

units.zh: 鳥夷皮服。
units.en: Coastal peoples sent furs and hides.
units.literal: Bird-barbarians offered furs.

units.zh: 夾右碣石，入于海。
units.en: Tribute went by way of Jieshi on the right and reached the sea.
units.literal: Flanking right Jieshi, entering the sea.

units.zh: 濟、河維沇州：九河既道，雷夏既澤，雍、沮會同，桑土既蠶，於是民得下丘居土。
units.en: Between the Ji and the Yellow River lay Yanzhou: the Nine Streams were channeled, Leixia became a lake, the Yong and Ju joined their waters, silkworms returned to the mulberry lands, and people could leave the heights for the plain.
units.literal: Ji and He were Yanzhou: the nine rivers already had their courses; Leixia already was a marsh; Yong and Ju met together; mulberry soil already had silkworms; then the people could descend from heights and dwell on earth.

units.zh: 其土黑墳，草繇木條。
units.en: The ground was dark fertile loam with thick grass and tall straight timber.
units.literal: Its soil was black and rich; grass luxuriant, trees straight.

units.zh: 田中下，賦貞，作十有三年乃同。
units.en: Fields ranked low-middle; the levy was set at the lowest regular grade until, after thirteen years of reclamation, it matched other districts.
units.literal: Fields lower middle; revenue fixed; after thirteen years then uniform.

units.zh: 其貢漆絲，其篚織文。
units.en: It sent lacquer and silk in tribute, and woven figured cloth in baskets.
units.literal: Its tribute lacquer and silk; its baskets patterned weave.

units.zh: 浮於濟、漯，通於河。
units.en: Shipments floated down the Ji and the Ta to join the Yellow River.
units.literal: Floated on Ji and Ta, communicating with He.

units.zh: 海岱維青州：堣夷既略，濰、淄其道。
units.en: Between the sea and Mount Dai lay Qingzhou: the Yuyi tribes were pacified, and the Wei and Zi were channeled.
units.literal: Sea and Dai were Qingzhou: Yuyi already subdued; Wei and Zi had their courses.

units.zh: 其土白墳，海濱廣潟，厥田斥鹵。
units.en: The soil was pale loam along a coast of wide tidal flats, much of it salt-encrusted.
units.literal: Its soil white loam; seashore broad marshes; its fields saline.

units.zh: 田上下，賦中上。
units.en: Fields ranked high among the lower grades; the tax was upper-middle.
units.literal: Fields upper lower; revenue middle upper.

units.zh: 厥貢鹽絺，海物維錯，岱畎絲、枲、鉛、松、怪石，萊夷為牧，其篚酓絲。
units.en: Tribute included salt, fine linen, a miscellany of sea produce, silk, and hemp from the Dai valleys, lead, pine, and odd stones; the Lai people sent pasture goods and silkworm baskets.
units.literal: Its tribute salt and fine cloth; sea things various; Dai's valleys silk, hemp, lead, pine, strange stones; Laiyi herded; its baskets mulberry silk.

units.zh: 浮於汶，通於濟。
units.en: It went by the Wen and linked to the Ji.
units.literal: Floated on Wen, communicating with Ji.

units.zh: 海岱及淮維徐州：淮、沂其治，蒙、羽其藝。
units.en: Between sea, Dai, and Huai lay Xuzhou: the Huai and Yi were tamed, and the Meng and Yu ranges were opened to the plough.
units.literal: Sea, Dai, and Huai were Xuzhou: Huai and Yi were regulated; Meng and Yu were cultivated.

units.zh: 大野既都，東原底平。
units.en: Daye marsh was diked, and the eastern lowlands lay smooth.
units.literal: The great marsh already settled; the eastern plain reached level.

units.zh: 其土赤埴墳，草木漸包。
units.en: The earth was sticky red clay, slowly clothing itself again in grass and wood.
units.literal: Its soil red sticky loam; grass and trees gradually encased.

units.zh: 其田上中，賦中中。
units.en: Fields ranked second grade; the tax was middling.
units.literal: Its fields upper middle; revenue middle middle.

units.zh: 貢維土五色，羽畎夏狄，嶧陽孤桐，泗濱浮磬，淮夷蠙珠臮魚，其篚玄纖縞。
units.en: It sent five-colored clays, pheasant tails from the Yu valley, lone paulownia from Yiyang, floating lithophones from the Si, pearls and fish from the Huai tribes, and baskets of fine dark silk.
units.literal: Tribute earth of five colors; summer pheasant plumes from Yu's valley; lone paulownia from Yiyang; floating chime-stones from the Si bank; pearls and fish from Huaiyi; its baskets black fine silk.

units.zh: 浮于淮、泗，通于河。
units.en: Shipments moved on the Huai and Si to reach the Yellow River.
units.literal: Floated on Huai and Si, communicating with He.

units.zh: 淮海維揚州：彭蠡既都，陽鳥所居。
units.en: Between the Huai and the sea lay Yangzhou: Lake Pengli was stabilized and became a haunt for wintering birds.
units.literal: Huai and sea were Yangzhou: Pengli already settled; where the yang birds dwell.

units.zh: 三江既入，震澤致定。
units.en: The three great channels poured in, and Lake Tai was calmed.
units.literal: Three rivers already entered; Zhenze reached stability.

units.zh: 竹箭既布。
units.en: Bamboo groves for arrows flourished far and wide.
units.literal: Bamboo arrows already spread.

units.zh: 其草惟夭，其木惟喬，其土涂泥。
units.en: Grasses were tender, trees towered, and the soil was mire.
units.literal: Its grass only young; its trees only tall; its soil mud.

units.zh: 田下下，賦下上上雜。
units.en: Fields were the poorest grade; the levy was the top of the bottom tier with some higher admixture.
units.literal: Fields lowest lowest; revenue lowest upper upper mixed.

units.zh: 貢金三品，瑤、琨、竹箭，齒、革、羽、旄，島夷卉服，其篚織貝，其包橘、柚錫貢。
units.en: Tribute brought three grades of metal, jade and fine stone, bamboo for arrows, ivory, hides, feathers, and yak tails; island peoples sent plant-fiber garments; baskets held patterned shells; and bundled oranges and pomelos were sent as gifts.
units.literal: Tribute included three grades of metal, jade, fine stone, bamboo arrows, ivory, hides, feathers, and yak-tail; island peoples sent plant-fiber dress; baskets held patterned shells; bundles of citrus were granted as tribute gifts.

units.zh: 均江海，通淮、泗。
units.en: He linked the Yangtze to the sea and opened routes to the Huai and Si.
units.literal: Evened Jiang and sea, communicating Huai and Si.

units.zh: 荆及衡陽維荆州：江、漢朝宗于海。
units.en: From Mount Jing to south of Mount Heng lay Jingzhou: the Yangtze and Han flowed as tributaries to the sea.
units.literal: Jing and south of Heng were Jingzhou: Jiang and Han paid court to the sea.

units.zh: 九江甚中，沱、涔已道，雲土、夢爲治。
units.en: The nine channels of the middle Yangtze were cleared, the Tuo and Cen confined, and the Yunmeng marshes brought under control.
units.literal: Nine Jiang very central; Tuo and Cen already channeled; cloud-earth and dream reached regulation.

units.zh: 其土塗泥。
units.en: The ground was alluvial muck.
units.literal: Its soil mud.

units.zh: 田下中，賦上下。
units.en: Fields ranked low-middle; taxes upper-lower.
units.literal: Fields lower middle; revenue upper lower.

units.zh: 貢羽、旄、齒、革，金三品，杶、榦、栝、柏，礪、砥、砮、丹，維箘簬、楛，三國致貢其名，包匭菁茅，其篚玄纁璣組，九江入賜大龜。
units.en: Tribute ran to feathers, furs, ivory, hides, three grades of ore, hardwoods, whetstones, cinnabar, and specialty bamboos; the three chiefdoms each sent their specialties, along with wrapped iris and thatch, baskets of dark silk, strings of pearls, and, from the Nine Streams, the great tortoise as an imperial gift.
units.literal: Tribute ran to feathers, furs, ivory, hides, three grades of ore, hardwoods, whetstones, cinnabar, and specialty bamboos; the three chiefdoms each sent their specialties, wrapped iris and thatch, baskets of dark silk, strings of pearls, and from the nine streams the great tortoise as an imperial gift.

units.zh: 浮于江、沱、涔、（于）漢，踰于雒，至于南河。
units.en: Goods floated on the Yangtze, Tuo, and Cen to the Han, then were portaged to the Luo and the southern Yellow River.
units.literal: Floated on Jiang, Tuo, Cen, to Han, crossed to Luo, reaching south He.

units.zh: 荊河惟豫州：伊、雒、瀍、澗既入于河，滎播既都，道荷澤，被明都。
units.en: Between the Jing mountains and the Yellow River lay Yuzhou: the Yi, Luo, Chan, and Jian were led into the main stream, Lake Xingbo was diked, the He marsh was opened, and Mingdu was flooded out.
units.literal: Jing and He were Yuzhou: Yi, Luo, Chan, and Jian already entered He; Xingbo already settled; channeled He marsh, spread Mingdu.

units.zh: 其土壤，下土墳壚。
units.en: The upland was loess; the low ground heavier clay.
units.literal: Its soil was soft loam; the lower soil was fertile clay.

units.zh: 田中上，賦雜上中。
units.en: Fields were second grade; the tax blended upper and middle rates.
units.literal: Fields middle upper; revenue mixed upper middle.

units.zh: 貢漆、絲、絺、紵，其篚纖絮，錫貢磬錯。
units.en: It sent lacquer, silk, fine linen, and kudzu fiber in baskets of fine batting, with lithophone ore as an occasional gift.
units.literal: Tribute lacquer, silk, fine cloth, hemp; its baskets fine floss; granted tribute chime-stone ore.

units.zh: 浮於雒，達於河。
units.en: Shipments floated down the Luo to the Yellow River.
units.literal: Floated on Luo, reaching He.

units.zh: 華陽黑水惟梁州：汶、嶓既藝，沱、涔既道，蔡、蒙旅平，和夷厎績。
units.en: South of Mount Hua to the Black Water was Liangzhou: the Min and Bo were farmed, the Tuo and Cen confined, the Cai and Meng ranges cleared, and the He tribes brought in order.
units.literal: South of Hua and Black Water were Liangzhou: Min and Bo already cultivated; Tuo and Cen already channeled; Cai and Meng journeyed level; He yi reached merit.

units.zh: 其土青驪。
units.en: The soil was dark loam.
units.literal: Its soil green-black.

units.zh: 田下上，賦下中三錯。
units.en: Fields ranked low among the high grades; the levy shifted among three lower-middle levels.
units.literal: Fields lower upper; revenue lower middle three mixed.

units.zh: 貢璆、鐵、銀、鏤、砮、磬，熊、羆、狐、貍、織皮。
units.en: It yielded fine jade, iron, silver, hammered metal, lithophones, and pelts of bear, brown bear, fox, and wildcat.
units.literal: Tribute jade, iron, silver, carved bells, lithophones, bears, brown bears, foxes, wildcats, woven hides.

units.zh: 西傾因桓是來，浮于潛，踰于沔，入于渭，亂于河。
units.en: From West Qin the route followed the Huan, then floated on the Qian, was portaged to the Mian, joined the Wei, and crossed to the Yellow River.
units.literal: West Qin by Huan came; floated on Qian, crossed Mian, entered Wei, crossed He.

units.zh: 黑水西河惟雍州：弱水既西，涇屬渭汭。
units.en: West of the Black Water to the Yellow River was Yongzhou: the Weak River was turned westward, and the Jing joined the Wei at its bend.
units.literal: Black Water west of He was Yongzhou: weak water already west; Jing joined Wei's north bank.

units.zh: 漆、沮既從，灃水所同。
units.en: The Qi and Ju obeyed their channels, and the Feng mingled where appointed.
units.literal: Qi and Ju already followed; Feng water shared the same.

units.zh: 荊、岐已旅，終南、敦物至于鳥鼠。
units.en: The Jing and Qi ranges were cleared from Zhongnan and Dunwu to Niaoshu.
units.literal: Jing and Qi already journeyed; Zhongnan, Dunwu reached Niaoshu.

units.zh: 原隰厎績，至于都野。
units.en: High moors and sunken bogs were drained as far as Duye.
units.literal: High plain and low marsh reached merit, reaching Duye.

units.zh: 三危既度，三苗大序。
units.en: The Sanwei region was surveyed, and the Sanmiao tribes were brought into line.
units.literal: Three Perils already measured; Three Miao greatly ordered.

units.zh: 其土黃壤。
units.en: The earth was yellow loam.
units.literal: Its soil yellow loam.

units.zh: 田上上，賦中下。
units.en: Fields were the finest grade; the tax was set middle-lower to reflect distance.
units.literal: Fields highest highest; revenue middle lower.

units.zh: 貢璆、琳、瑯玕。
units.en: It sent jade, fine stone, and carnelian.
units.literal: Tribute jade, fine jade, carnelian.

units.zh: 浮于積石，至于龍門西河，會于渭汭。
units.en: Shipments floated from Jishi to Longmen on the western Yellow River and gathered at the Wei's bend.
units.literal: Floated on Jishi, reaching Longmen west He, meeting at Wei's north bank.

units.zh: 織皮昆侖、析支、渠搜，西戎即序。
units.en: Tribute furs came from Kunlun, Xizhi, and Qusou, and the western Rong were enrolled.
units.literal: Woven hides Kunlun, Xizhi, Qusou; western Rong already ordered.

units.zh: 道九山：汧及岐至于荊山，踰于河；
units.en: He traced nine mountain chains: from Qian and Qi to Jingshan, then across the Yellow River.
units.literal: He opened nine mountains: Qian and Qi reaching Jingshan, crossing He.

units.zh: 壺口、雷首至于太嶽；
units.en: From Hukou and Leishou to Taiyue.
units.literal: Hukou, Leishou reaching Taiyue.

units.zh: 砥柱、析城至于王屋；
units.en: From Dizhu and Xicheng to Wangwu.
units.literal: Dizhu, Xicheng reaching Wangwu.

units.zh: 太行、常山至于碣石，入于海；
units.en: From Taihang and Hengshan to Jieshi and into the sea.
units.literal: Taihang, Changshan reaching Jieshi, entering the sea.

units.zh: 西傾、朱圉、鳥鼠至于太華；
units.en: From West Qin, Zhuyu, and Niaoshu to Taihua.
units.literal: West Qin, Zhuyu, Niaoshu reaching Taihua.

units.zh: 熊耳、外方、桐柏至于負尾；
units.en: From Xiong'er, Waifang, and Tongbai to Fuwei.
units.literal: Xiong'er, Waifang, Tongbai reaching Fuwei.

units.zh: 道嶓冢，至于荊山；
units.en: He opened the Bozhong range to Jingshan.
units.literal: He opened Bozhong, reaching Jingshan.

units.zh: 內方至于大別；
units.en: From Neifang to Dabie.
units.literal: Neifang reaching Dabie.

units.zh: 汶山之陽至衡山，過九江，至于敷淺原。
units.en: From the southern slopes of Minshan to Hengshan, across the nine streams, to Fushaoyuan.
units.literal: South of Mount Min's range to Hengshan, crossing nine Jiang, reaching Fushaoyuan.

units.zh: 道九川：弱水至於合黎，餘波入于流沙。
units.en: He channeled nine rivers: the Weak to Heli, its tail into the shifting sands.
units.literal: He opened nine streams: weak water reaching Heli, surplus waves entering flowing sands.

units.zh: 道黑水，至于三危，入于南海。
units.en: He led the Black Water to Sanwei and out into the southern sea.
units.literal: He opened Black Water, reaching Three Perils, entering south sea.

units.zh: 道河積石，至于龍門，南至華陰，東至砥柱，又東至于盟津，東過雒汭，至于大邳，北過降水，至于大陸，北播為九河，同為逆河，入于海。
units.en: He guided the Yellow River from Jishi and Longmen south to Huayin, east past the pillars at Mengjin, across the Luo bend to Dapi, north past the Jiang to the great alluvial plain, where it fanned into the nine channels and the backwash belt before reaching the sea.
units.literal: He opened He Jishi, reaching Longmen, south reaching Huayin, east reaching Dizhu, again east reaching Mengjin, east crossing Luo's bend, reaching Dapi, north crossing Jiangshui, reaching Dalu, north spreading as nine He, together reverse He, entering sea.

units.zh: 嶓冢道瀁，東流為漢，又東為蒼浪之水，過三澨，入于大別，南入于江，東匯澤為彭蠡，東為北江，入于海。
units.en: From Bozhong he opened the Han, turned it east through the Canglang reaches and three gorges to Dabie, then south into the Yangtze, east into Lake Pengli, and east again as the northern stream to the sea.
units.literal: Bozhong opened Yang, east flowing became Han, again east became Canglang water, passed three rapids, entered Dabie, south entered Jiang, east collected marsh as Pengli, east became north Jiang, entered sea.

units.zh: 汶山道江，東別為沱，又東至于醴，過九江，至于東陵，東迆北會于匯，東為中江，入于梅。
units.en: From Minshan he split the Yangtze's eastern arm as the Tuo, led it past the Li reaches and the nine channels to Dongling, bent north to the confluence, and opened the middle stream to the sea.
units.literal: Minshan opened Jiang, east divided became Tuo, again east reached Li, crossed nine Jiang, reached Dongling, east winding north met at Hui, east became middle Jiang, entered Mei.

units.zh: 道沇水，東為濟，入于河，泆為滎，東出陶丘北，又東至于荷，又東北會于汶，又東北入于海。
units.en: He channeled the Yan into the Ji to the Yellow River, where it burst forth as the Xing pool, ran east from north of Taoqiu to the He marsh, then northeast by the Wen to the sea.
units.literal: He opened Yan water, east became Ji, entered He, overflowed became Xing, east emerged north of Taoqiu, again east reached He, again northeast met Wen, again northeast entered sea.

units.zh: 道淮自桐柏，東會于泗、沂，東入于海。
units.en: He traced the Huai from Tongbai east to join the Si and Yi, then to the sea.
units.literal: He opened Huai from Tongbai, east met Si and Yi, east entered sea.

units.zh: 道渭自鳥鼠同穴，東會于灃，又東北至于涇，東過漆、沮，入于河。
units.en: He opened the Wei from Niaoshu, east to the Feng, northeast to the Jing, then past the Qi and Ju into the Yellow River.
units.literal: He opened Wei from Niaoshu same-burrow, east met Feng, again northeast reached Jing, east crossing Qi and Ju, entered He.

units.zh: 道雒自熊耳，東北會于澗、瀍，又東會于伊，東北入于河。
units.en: He led the Luo from Xiong'er northeast through the Jian and Chan, east to meet the Yi, and northeast into the Yellow River.
units.literal: He opened Luo from Xiong'er, northeast met Jian and Chan, again east met Yi, northeast entered He.

units.zh: 於是九州攸同，四奧既居，九山刊旅，九川滌原，九澤既陂，四海會同。
units.en: Then the nine provinces became one realm; the mountains were cleared, the rivers scoured their beds, the marshes were diked, and the four seas were joined as one.
units.literal: Thereupon the nine provinces were made one; the four reaches had their dwellings; the nine mountains were cut and traveled; the nine streams were dredged and the plains cleared; the nine marshes were banked; the four seas met in accord.

units.zh: 六府甚修，眾土交正，致慎財賦，咸則三壤成賦。
units.en: The six storehouses were stocked; soils were assayed; taxes were set with care; every grade of earth paid its due.
units.literal: Six treasuries very cultivated; all soils mutually corrected; careful with wealth and levies; all modeled three soils completing revenue.

units.zh: 中國賜土姓：「祗臺德先，不距朕行。」
units.en: The central lands were granted clan names and told: "Honor virtue above all and do not defy my rule."
units.literal: The central lands were granted clan names: "Honor virtue before all and do not defy my rule."

units.zh: 令天子之國以外五百里甸服：百里賦納總，二百里納銍，三百里納秸服，四百里粟，五百里米。
units.en: He fixed the five-hundred-li royal domain: the inner hundred li sent whole stalks, the next grain ears, the next fodder and labor, then millet, then rice at the rim.
units.literal: He ordered beyond the Son of Heaven's domain five hundred li field-domain: hundred li tribute bound sheaves, two hundred li ears of grain, three hundred li straw service, four hundred li grain, five hundred li polished rice.

units.zh: 甸服外五百里侯服：百里采，二百里任國，三百里諸侯。
units.en: Beyond that lay another five hundred li for the lords: inner districts for court estates, next for assigned service, outer for the feudal order.
units.literal: Field-domain outer five hundred li lord-domain: hundred li gathering, two hundred li duty states, three hundred li feudal lords.

units.zh: 侯服外五百里綏服：三百里揆文教，二百里奮武衛。
units.en: Outside that came the pacification belt: inner tracts for civil instruction, outer for military screen.
units.literal: Lord-domain outer five hundred li peace-domain: three hundred li measure culture-teaching, two hundred li vigorous martial guard.

units.zh: 綏服外五百里要服：三百里夷，二百里蔡。
units.en: Next was the coercive belt: inner Yi peoples, outer Cai settlements.
units.literal: Peace-domain outer five hundred li binding-domain: three hundred li yi, two hundred li cai.

units.zh: 要服外五百里荒服：三百里蠻，二百里流。
units.en: Outermost lay the wilds: inner Man tribes, outer exiles.
units.literal: Binding-domain outer five hundred li wild-domain: three hundred li man, two hundred li flow.

units.zh: 東漸于海，西被于流沙，朔、南暨：聲教訖于四海。
units.en: East to the ocean, west to the sands, north and south alike—his influence reached every shore.
units.literal: East washed to sea, west covered to shifting sands, north and south reached: sound and teaching ended at four seas.

units.zh: 於是帝錫禹玄圭，以告成功于天下。
units.en: The Emperor gave Yu a black scepter to proclaim the work finished to the realm.
units.literal: Thereupon the Emperor granted Yu dark jade tablet, thereby announcing success to all under Heaven.

units.zh: 天下於是大平治。
units.en: The realm then knew great peace.
units.literal: All under Heaven thereupon greatly peaceful order.

units.zh: 皋陶作士以理民。
units.en: Gao Yao acted as judge to keep order among the people.
units.literal: Gao Yao served as minister to regulate the people.

units.zh: 帝舜朝，禹、伯夷、皋陶相與語帝前。
units.en: At Shun's audience Yu, Boyi, and Gao Yao debated policy before the throne.
units.literal: Emperor Shun at court, Yu, Boyi, Gao Yao conversed with each other before the Emperor.

units.zh: 皋陶述其謀曰：「信其道德，謀明輔和。」
units.en: Gao Yao said, "Hold fast to true virtue and clear counsel, and harmony will follow."
units.literal: Gao Yao set forth his plan, saying, "Trust his virtue and way; counsel clear, assist harmony."

units.zh: 禹曰：「然，如何？」
units.en: Yu asked, "Agreed—but how do we put that into practice?"
units.literal: Yu said, "Yes—how shall we do it?"

units.zh: 皋陶曰：「於！
units.en: Gao Yao cried, "Ah!
units.literal: Gao Yao said, "Oh!

units.zh: 慎其身修，思長，敦序九族，眾明高翼，近可遠在已。」
units.en: Watch your own conduct, plan far ahead, cherish the nine branches of kin, lift the worthy, and what is near in yourself will reach what is far."
units.literal: Careful with body cultivation, thinking long, generous ordering nine kin, many bright high wings, near can far in self."

units.zh: 禹拜美言，曰：「然。」
units.en: Yu bowed and said, "Well spoken—it is so."
units.literal: Yu bowed praising the words, saying, "Yes."

units.zh: 皋陶曰：「於！
units.en: Gao Yao cried, "Ah!
units.literal: Gao Yao said, "Oh!

units.zh: 在知人，在安民。」
units.en: Know your officers and secure the people."
units.literal: In knowing men, in pacifying the people."

units.zh: 禹曰：「吁！
units.en: Yu cried, "Oh—
units.literal: Yu said, "Alas!

units.zh: 皆若是，惟帝其難之。
units.en: If everyone did that, even a sage on the throne would find it hard.
units.literal: If all were thus, only the Emperor would find it hard.

units.zh: 知人則智，能官人；
units.en: To know men is wisdom and lets you place each in his post.
units.literal: Knowing men then wise, able to appoint men;

units.zh: 能安民則惠，黎民懷之。
units.en: To pacify the people is kindness, and the common folk will cleave to you.
units.literal: able to pacify people then kind, black-haired people cherish him.

units.zh: 能知能惠，何憂乎驩兜，何遷乎有苗，何畏乎巧言善色佞人？」
units.en: With both wisdom and kindness, why fear Huandou, why exile the Miao, why dread smooth talk and pretty faces?"
units.literal: Able to know able to kind, what worry about Huandou, what banish about Youmiao, what fear about clever words fine faces flatterers?"

units.zh: 皋陶曰：「然，於！
units.en: Gao Yao said, "Just so—indeed!
units.literal: Gao Yao said, "Yes—oh!

units.zh: 亦行有九德，亦言其有德。」
units.en: In conduct there are nine virtues; in words there are signs of them."
units.literal: Also conduct has nine virtues; also speech has its virtue."

units.zh: 乃言曰：「始事事，寬而栗，柔而立，願而共，治而敬，擾而毅，直而溫，簡而廉，剛而實，彊而義，章其有常，吉哉。
units.en: They are: "to be generous yet disciplined, gentle yet firm, tractable yet dignified, orderly yet reverent, teachable yet resolute, candid yet mild, spare yet honest, stern yet true, forceful yet just. Show these as steady habits, and all will be well.
units.literal: Then saying, "Begin affairs: broad yet firm, soft yet standing, obedient yet respectful, ordered yet reverent, adaptable yet resolute, straight yet warm, simple yet incorrupt, hard yet solid, strong yet righteous—manifest their constancy—auspicious.

units.zh: 日宣三德，蚤夜翊明有家。
units.en: Practice three virtues each day, morning and night, and you may govern a household.
units.literal: Daily spread three virtues, early night assist bright having family.

units.zh: 日嚴振敬六德，亮采有國。
units.en: Strictly maintain six virtues with daily care, and you may rule a state.
units.literal: Daily strict shake reverence six virtues, bright gathering having state.

units.zh: 翕受普施，九德咸事，俊乂在官，百吏肅謹。
units.en: Welcome all talents, put the nine virtues to work, place the able in office, and every clerk will stand in awe.
units.literal: Receive together spread broadly, nine virtues all affairs, outstanding ones in office, hundred clerks reverent careful.

units.zh: 毋教邪淫奇謀。
units.en: Never teach lewd ways or crooked schemes.
units.literal: Do not teach deviant evil strange plots.

units.zh: 非其人居其官，是謂亂天事。
units.en: Put the wrong man in a post and you throw Heaven's business into chaos.
units.literal: Not its man dwelling its office—this is called disorder Heaven's affairs.

units.zh: 天討有罪，五刑五用哉。
units.en: Heaven punishes crime; the five penalties have their five uses.
units.literal: Heaven punishes guilty; five punishments five applications.

units.zh: 吾言厎可行乎？」
units.en: Can my words be carried out in practice?"
units.literal: My words bottom can be practiced?"

units.zh: 禹曰：「女言致可績行。」
units.en: Yu said, "What you say can be carried out and will show results."
units.literal: Yu said, "Your words reach can be traced in practice."

units.zh: 皋陶曰：「余未有知，思贊道哉。」
units.en: Gao Yao said, "I know little myself—I only wish to help along the right path."
units.literal: Gao Yao said, "I have no knowledge; I think only to assist the way."

units.zh: 帝舜謂禹曰：「女亦昌言。」
units.en: Emperor Shun said to Yu, "You speak plainly in your turn."
units.literal: Emperor Shun told Yu, "You also speak expansively."

units.zh: 禹拜曰；
units.en: Yu bowed to speak.
units.literal: Yu bowed saying;

units.zh: 「於，予何言！
units.en: Yu said, "Ah—what more is there for me to say!
units.literal: Yu said, "Ah—what shall I say!

units.zh: 予思日孳孳。」
units.en: Day and night I have only labored without rest."
units.literal: I think daily diligent diligent."

units.zh: 皋陶難禹曰：「何謂孳孳？」
units.en: Gao Yao pressed him: "What do you mean by striving without ceasing?"
units.literal: Gao Yao pressed Yu saying, "What is called diligent diligent?"

units.zh: 禹曰：「鴻水滔天，浩浩懷山襄陵，下民皆服於水。
units.en: Yu answered, "When the flood rose to the sky, wrapped the hills, and overtopped the valleys, the people were trapped in the waters.
units.literal: Yu said, "The vast flood swelled to heaven; vastly it embraced mountains and overflowed hills; the common people were all submerged in the waters.

units.zh: 予陸行乘車，水行乘舟，泥行乘橇，山行乘檋，行山刊木。
units.en: I rode a carriage on dry ground, boats on the water, sledges in mud, litters in the hills, and cut paths through the forests.
units.literal: I land rode carriage, water rode boat, mud rode sledge, mountain rode litter, marched mountains cut trees.

units.zh: 與益予眾庶稻鮮食。
units.en: With Yi, I gave the people grain and fresh meat from the marshes.
units.literal: Together with Yi gave multitude rice fresh food.

units.zh: 以決九川致四海，浚畎澮致之川。
units.en: I opened the nine rivers to the four seas and deepened the field channels into the trunk streams.
units.literal: To decide nine streams reach four seas, dredged ditches channels reach them streams.

units.zh: 與稷予眾庶難得之食。
units.en: With Ji, I supplied food wherever famine struck.
units.literal: Together with Ji gave multitude hard-to-obtain food.

units.zh: 食少，調有餘補不足，徙居。
units.en: Where grain ran short I shifted surplus to cover want and resettled the people.
units.literal: Food scarce, adjusted surplus mending shortage, moved dwellings.

units.zh: 眾民乃定，萬國為治。」
units.en: Then the masses found a home and the myriad regions were governed."
units.literal: Multitude people then settled, myriad states for order."

units.zh: 皋陶曰：「然，此而美也。」
units.en: Gao Yao said, "Truly—this is the finest of policies."
units.literal: Gao Yao said, "Yes—this indeed beautiful."

units.zh: 禹曰：「於，帝！
units.en: Yu said, "Ah, my lord!
units.literal: Yu said, "Ah! O Sovereign!

units.zh: 慎乃在位，安爾止。
units.en: Be careful in your office and keep your footing secure.
units.literal: Be careful in your position; settle your steps.

units.zh: 輔德，天下大應。
units.en: Support true virtue, and the whole realm will answer you.
units.literal: Support virtue, and all under Heaven will respond.

units.zh: 清意以昭待上帝命，天其重命用休。」
units.en: With a clear heart await Heaven's command, and Heaven will renew its blessing."
units.literal: With a pure intent make clear your waiting on Heaven's command; Heaven will again bestow its favor."

units.zh: 帝曰：「吁，臣哉，臣哉！
units.en: The Emperor said, "Alas, my ministers, my ministers!
units.literal: The Emperor said, "Alas—ministers, ministers!

units.zh: 臣作朕股肱耳目。
units.en: You are my arms and legs, my eyes and ears.
units.literal: You serve as my thighs and arms, my eyes and ears.

units.zh: 予欲左右有民，女輔之。
units.en: I wish to guide and sustain the people; you must aid me.
units.literal: I wish to support and have the people; you assist me.

units.zh: 余欲觀古人之象。
units.en: I wish to read the pattern of the ancients.
units.literal: I wish to observe the pattern of the ancients.

units.zh: 日月星辰，作文繡服色，女明之。
units.en: Let the sun, moon, and stars pattern the robes and insignia; you shall set them in order.
units.literal: Sun, moon, and stars—make patterned robes and colors; you make them bright.

units.zh: 予欲聞六律五聲八音，來始滑，以出入五言，女聽。
units.en: I would hear the six pitch-pipes, five notes, and eight timbres in harmony; you shall attune them.
units.literal: I wish to hear the six pitch-pipes, five tones, and eight sounds harmonized; you listen.

units.zh: 予即辟，女匡拂予。
units.en: If I go astray, correct and steady me.
units.literal: I if biased, you correct assist me.

units.zh: 女無面諛。
units.en: Do not flatter me to my face.
units.literal: You do not face flatter.

units.zh: 退而謗予。
units.en: Nor slander me behind my back.
units.literal: Retiring then slander me.

units.zh: 敬四輔臣。
units.en: Honor the four pillar ministers.
units.literal: Revere the four supporting ministers.

units.zh: 諸眾讒嬖臣，君德誠施皆清矣。」
units.en: If slanderers and favorites abound, let your true virtue shine through and all will be clear."
units.literal: As for many slander favorite ministers, lord virtue sincerely spread all clear."

units.zh: 禹曰：「然。
units.en: Yu said, "It is so.
units.literal: Yu said, "Yes.

units.zh: 帝即不時，布同善惡則毋功。」
units.en: If the Son of Heaven is out of step and spreads the same measure to good and evil alike, we shall accomplish nothing."
units.literal: Emperor if not timely, spread same good evil then no merit."

units.zh: 帝曰：「毋若丹朱傲，維慢游是好，毋水行舟，朋淫于家，用絕其世。
units.en: The Emperor said: "Do not be like Danzhu, proud and idle, who boated for pleasure, debauched his household, and lost his line.
units.literal: Emperor said, Do not be like Danzhu arrogant, only slow wandering is his love, only water go boat, flock licentious in house, use cut off his generations.

units.zh: 予不能順是。」
units.en: I cannot follow such a course."
units.literal: I cannot follow this."

units.zh: 禹曰：「予（辛壬）娶涂山，［辛壬］癸甲，生啟予不子，以故能成水土功。
units.en: Yu said, "I wed a woman of Tushan after four days away; when our son Qi was born I did not dote on him—thus I finished the flood work.
units.literal: Yu said, "I married a woman of Tushan on the days xin and ren; on gui and jia Qi was born, and I did not treat him as a son, and thereby could complete the earth-and-water works."

units.zh: 輔成五服，至于五千里，州十二師，外薄四海，咸建五長，各道有功。
units.en: I helped shape the five zones out to five thousand li, set twelve divisions in each province, reached to the rim of the seas, appointed five regional overseers, and urged every district to earn its keep.
units.literal: Assist complete five domains, reaching five thousand li, twelve divisions per province, outer thin four seas, all establish five chiefs, each guide having merit.

units.zh: 苗頑不即功，帝其念哉。」
units.en: Only the Miao remained stubborn—think of them, my lord."
units.literal: Miao stubborn not approach merit, Emperor should think on them."

units.zh: 帝曰：「道吾德，乃女功序之也。」
units.en: The Emperor answered, "It is your ordering of merit that spreads my virtue."
units.literal: Emperor said, "Conducting my virtue is your ordering the merit."

units.zh: 皋陶於是敬禹之德，令民皆則禹。
units.en: Gao Yao then honored Yu's example and told the people to imitate him.
units.literal: Gao Yao thereupon revered Yu's virtue, ordered people all model Yu.

units.zh: 不如言，刑從之。
units.en: Those who defied his commands faced the law.
units.literal: If not matching words, punishment follows them.

units.zh: 舜德大明。
units.en: Shun's virtue shone the brighter for it.
units.literal: Shun's virtue greatly bright.

units.zh: 於是夔行樂，祖考至，群后相讓，鳥獸翔舞，簫韶九成，鳳皇來儀，百獸率舞，百官信諧。
units.en: Then Kui played the Nine Shao; the ancestral spirits drew near; the lords yielded to one another; birds and beasts danced; phoenixes appeared; every creature joined the measure, and the officers moved in perfect accord.
units.literal: Thereupon Kui performed music; ancestral spirits arrived; the host of lords yielded to one another; birds and beasts soared and danced; the Xiao Shao nine times completed; phoenixes came in ritual posture; hundred beasts led the dance; hundred officers trusted in harmony.

units.zh: 帝用此作歌曰：「陟天之命，維時維幾。」
units.en: The Emperor made a song: "Heaven's charge is high—mind the seasons and the perilous moments."
units.literal: Emperor using this made song, saying, "Ascend Heaven's mandate, only season only danger."

units.zh: 乃歌曰：「股肱喜哉，元首起哉，百工熙哉！」
units.en: He sang, "Joy to our limbs! Awake, our head! Brightly thrive all crafts!"
units.literal: Then sang, "Thighs arms joyful! Head rises! Hundred crafts bright!"

units.zh: 皋陶拜手稽首揚言曰：「念哉，率為興事，慎乃憲，敬哉！」
units.en: Gao Yao bowed and cried, "Remember this! Lead in raising affairs; watch your pattern—be reverent, be reverent!"
units.literal: Gao Yao bowed with hands to forehead and raised his voice, saying, "Think on it! Lead in raising affairs; be careful of your statutes—be reverent, be reverent!"

units.zh: 乃更為歌曰：「元首明哉，股肱良哉，庶事康哉！」
units.en: He sang in turn, "The head is wise! The limbs are good! All affairs are at peace!"
units.literal: Then changed making song, saying, "Head bright! Thighs arms good! Multitude matters peaceful!"

units.zh: （舜）又歌曰：「元首叢脞哉，股肱惰哉，萬事墮哉！」
units.en: Shun sang again, "If the head is muddled, the limbs grow slack, and every task collapses!"
units.literal: (Shun) again sang, "Head cluttered! Thighs arm lazy! Myriad matters ruin!"

units.zh: 帝拜曰：「然，往欽哉！」
units.en: The Emperor bowed and said, "Yes—go and be reverent!"
units.literal: The Emperor bowed and said, "Yes—go and be reverent, be reverent!"

units.zh: 於是天下皆宗禹之明度數聲樂，為山川神主。
units.en: Then all under Heaven took Yu's calendrics, measures, and music as their model and made him lord of mountains and rivers.
units.literal: Thereupon all under Heaven took as model Yu's brightness, measures, numbers, and music, and made him lord of mountains and rivers.

units.zh: 帝舜薦禹於天，為嗣。
units.en: Emperor Shun presented Yu to Heaven as successor.
units.literal: Emperor Shun recommended Yu to Heaven, as heir.

units.zh: 十七年而帝舜崩。
units.en: Seventeen years later Emperor Shun died.
units.literal: Seventeen years then Emperor Shun passed away.

units.zh: 三年喪畢，禹辭辟舜之子商均於陽城。
units.en: When the three years' mourning ended, Yu withdrew to Yangcheng to yield to Shun's son Shangjun.
units.literal: Three years mourning finished, Yu declined yielding to Shun's son Shangjun at Yangcheng.

units.zh: 天下諸侯皆去商均而朝禹。
units.en: The lords of the realm forsook Shangjun and turned to Yu.
units.literal: All under Heaven lords all left Shangjun and courted Yu.

units.zh: 禹於是遂即天子位，南面朝天下，國號曰夏后，姓姒氏。
units.en: Yu then took the throne, faced south over the realm, styled his dynasty Xia, and took the clan name Si.
units.literal: Yu thereupon then assumed Son of Heaven position, south faced all under Heaven, state title said Xia hou, surname Si clan.

units.zh: 帝禹立而舉皋陶薦之，且授政焉，而皋陶卒。
units.en: When Emperor Yu came to power he promoted Gao Yao and meant to hand him the government, but Gao Yao died.
units.literal: Emperor Yu established and raised Gao Yao recommending him, and was about to transfer government, but Gao Yao died.

units.zh: 封皋陶之後於英、六，或在許。
units.en: He enfeoffed Gao Yao's descendants at Ying, Liu, and perhaps Xu.
units.literal: He enfeoffed Gao Yao's posterity at Ying and Liu, or at Xu.

units.zh: 而后舉益，任之政。
units.en: Later he raised Yi and entrusted him with administration.
units.literal: Then afterward raised Yi, entrusted him government.

units.zh: 十年，帝禹東巡狩，至于會稽而崩。
units.en: In the tenth year of his reign Yu toured east to Kuaiji and died there.
units.literal: Ten years, Emperor Yu east toured inspection, reaching Kuaiji then passed away.

units.zh: 以天下授益。
units.en: He left the realm to Yi.
units.literal: He gave all under Heaven to Yi.

units.zh: 三年之喪畢，益讓帝禹之子啟，而辟居箕山之陽。
units.en: After the mourning Yi yielded to Yu's son Qi and withdrew south of Mount Ji.
units.literal: Three years mourning finished, Yi yielded to Emperor Yu's son Qi, and declined dwelling south of Mount Ji.

units.zh: 禹子啟賢，天下屬意焉。
units.en: Yu's son Qi was worthy, and the realm's hopes settled on him.
units.literal: Yu's son Qi worthy, all under Heaven fixed intent on him.

units.zh: 及禹崩，雖授益，益之佐禹日淺，天下未洽。
units.en: Though Yu had named Yi, Yi had served at Yu's side too briefly to win the people's trust.
units.literal: When Yu passed away, although he gave Yi, Yi's assisting Yu days shallow, all under Heaven not harmonious.

units.zh: 故諸侯皆去益而朝啟，曰：「吾君帝禹之子也」。
units.en: So the lords left Yi and went to court with Qi, saying, "Our lord is the son of Emperor Yu."
units.literal: Therefore, the lords all left Yi and courted Qi, saying, "Our lord is the son of Emperor Yu."

units.zh: 於是啟遂即天子之位，是為夏后帝啟。
units.en: Qi then mounted the throne as Emperor Qi of Xia.
units.literal: Thereupon Qi then assumed Son of Heaven position, this is Xia hou Emperor Qi.

units.zh: 夏后帝啟，禹之子，其母涂山氏之女也。
units.en: Emperor Qi of Xia was Yu's son; his mother was a lady of Tushan.
units.literal: Xia hou Emperor Qi, Yu's son, his mother a woman of the Tushan clan.

units.zh: 有扈氏不服，啟伐之，大戰於甘。
units.en: When the Youhu refused submission, Qi attacked and fought the great battle of Gan.
units.literal: Youhu clan not submitting, Qi attacked them, great battle at Gan.

units.zh: 將戰，作甘誓，乃召六卿申之。
units.en: Before the fight he issued the Oath of Gan and called the six ministers to hear it.
units.literal: About to battle, made Gan oath, then summoned six ministers declaring it.

units.zh: 啟曰：「嗟！
units.en: Qi said, "Hear me!
units.literal: Qi said, "Oh!

units.zh: 六事之人，予誓告女：有扈氏威侮五行，怠棄三正，天用勦絕其命。
units.en: You who command the six hosts, I swear this to you: Youhu has insulted the Five Phases and spurned the Three Beginnings; Heaven therefore cuts off its mandate.
units.literal: You of the six hosts—I swear and declare to you: the Youhu clan has wantonly insulted the Five Processes and idly abandoned the Three Rectifiers; Heaven will destroy and cut off its mandate.

units.zh: 今予維共行天之罰。
units.en: I now join you in executing Heaven's sentence.
units.literal: Now I only together conduct Heaven's punishment.

units.zh: 左不攻于左，右不攻于右，女不共命。
units.en: Those on the left who fail the left wing, those on the right who fail the right—you disobey the command.
units.literal: Left not attacking at left, right not attacking at right, you not together mandate.

units.zh: 御非其馬之政，女不共命。
units.en: Charioteers who cannot master their teams—you likewise disobey.
units.literal: Charioteers not their horses' regulation, you not together mandate.

units.zh: 用命，賞于祖；
units.en: Whoever obeys will be rewarded at the ancestral shrine.
units.literal: Those who obey the command will be rewarded at the ancestral shrine.

units.zh: 不用命，僇于社，予則帑僇女。」
units.en: Whoever disobeys will be slain at the soil altar, you and your households with you."
units.literal: Those who do not obey the command will be executed at the earth altar; I will execute you and your wives and children."

units.zh: 遂滅有扈氏。
units.en: He then destroyed the Youhu.
units.literal: Thereupon extinguished Youhu clan.

units.zh: 天下咸朝。
units.en: The whole realm submitted.
units.literal: All under Heaven all courted.

units.zh: 夏后帝啟崩，子帝太康立。
units.en: When Emperor Qi died, his son Taikang succeeded.
units.literal: Xia hou Emperor Qi passed away, son Emperor Taikang established.

units.zh: 帝太康失國，昆弟五人，須于洛汭，作五子之歌。
units.en: Taikang lost the throne; five brothers waited at the Luo bend and composed the Song of the Five Sons.
units.literal: Emperor Taikang lost state, five elder brothers, waited at Luo's bend, made Song of the Five Sons.

units.zh: 太康崩，弟中康立，是為帝中康。
units.en: Taikang was succeeded by his brother Zhongkang, known as Emperor Zhongkang.
units.literal: Taikang passed away, younger brother Zhongkang established, this is Emperor Zhongkang.

units.zh: 帝中康時，羲、和湎淫，廢時亂日。
units.en: Under Zhongkang the Xi and He stewards sank into vice and threw the calendar into confusion.
units.literal: Emperor Zhongkang's time, Xi and He drowned in debauchery, abandoned seasons disordered days.

units.zh: 胤往征之，作胤征。
units.en: Yin marched to punish them and composed the Punitive Expedition of Yin.
units.literal: Yin went to punish them, composing the Yin Punitive Expedition.

units.zh: 中康崩，子帝相立。
units.en: Zhongkang died and his son Xiang ruled.
units.literal: Zhongkang passed away, son Emperor Xiang established.

units.zh: 帝相崩，子帝少康立。
units.en: Xiang died and his son Shaokang ruled.
units.literal: Emperor Xiang passed away, son Emperor Shaokang established.

units.zh: 帝少康崩，子帝予立。
units.en: Shaokang died and his son Zhu ruled.
units.literal: Emperor Shaokang passed away, son Emperor Zhu established.

units.zh: 帝予崩，子帝槐立。
units.en: Zhu died and his son Huai ruled.
units.literal: Emperor Zhu passed away, son Emperor Huai established.

units.zh: 帝槐崩，子帝芒立。
units.en: Huai died and his son Mang ruled.
units.literal: Emperor Huai passed away, son Emperor Mang established.

units.zh: 帝芒崩，子帝泄立。
units.en: Mang died and his son Xie ruled.
units.literal: Emperor Mang passed away, son Emperor Xie established.

units.zh: 帝泄崩，子帝不降立。
units.en: Xie died and his son Bujiang ruled.
units.literal: Emperor Xie passed away, son Emperor Bujiang established.

units.zh: 帝不降崩，弟帝扃立。
units.en: Bujiang died and his brother Jiong ruled.
units.literal: Emperor Bujiang passed away, younger brother Emperor Jiong established.

units.zh: 帝扃崩，子帝廑立。
units.en: Jiong died and his son Jin ruled.
units.literal: Emperor Jiong passed away, son Emperor Jin established.

units.zh: 帝廑崩，立帝不降之子孔甲，是為帝孔甲。
units.en: Jin died and Bujiang's son Kongjia took the throne as Emperor Kongjia.
units.literal: Emperor Jin passed away, established Emperor Bujiang's son Kongjia, this is Emperor Kongjia.

units.zh: 帝孔甲立，好方鬼神，事淫亂。
units.en: Kongjia turned to occult rites and sank into disorder.
units.literal: Emperor Kongjia established, loved methods ghosts spirits, affairs dissolute chaotic.

units.zh: 夏后氏德衰，諸侯畔之。
units.en: Xia's virtue waned and the lords rebelled.
units.literal: Xia hou virtue declined, lords rebelled them.

units.zh: 天降龍二，有雌雄，孔甲不能食，未得豢龍氏。
units.en: Heaven sent down a pair of dragons, but Kongjia could not feed them and had no Dragon-keepers.
units.literal: Heaven sent down dragons two, having male female, Kongjia could not feed them, not yet obtained Dragon-herd clan.

units.zh: 陶唐既衰，其后有劉累，學擾龍于豢龍氏，以事孔甲。
units.en: When the house of Taotang waned, a man named Liu Lei learned dragon-tending from the Dragon-keepers and served Kongjia.
units.literal: Taotang already declined, afterward had Liu Lei, learned tame dragons at Dragon-herd clan, to serve Kongjia.

units.zh: 孔甲賜之姓曰御龍氏，受豕韋之後。
units.en: Kongjia gave him the clan name Dragon-tamer and granted him the fief of the Shiwei line.
units.literal: Kongjia granted him the surname Dragon-tamer, and he received the succession of the Shiwei.

units.zh: 龍一雌死，以食夏后。
units.en: When the female dragon died, he presented its flesh to the Xia court.
units.literal: One female dragon died; he presented it as food to the Xia ruler.

units.zh: 夏后使求，懼而遷去。
units.en: When Xia demanded more, he fled in terror.
units.literal: Xia hou sent seek, feared then moved away.

units.zh: 孔甲崩，子帝皋立。
units.en: Kongjia died and his son Gao ruled.
units.literal: Kongjia passed away, son Emperor Gao established.

units.zh: 帝皋崩，子帝發立。
units.en: Gao died and his son Fa ruled.
units.literal: Emperor Gao passed away, son Emperor Fa established.

units.zh: 帝發崩，子帝履癸立，是為桀。
units.en: Fa died and his son Lügui was established; this was Jie.
units.literal: Emperor Fa passed away, son Emperor Lügui established, this is Jie.

units.zh: 帝桀之時，自孔甲以來而諸侯多畔夏，桀不務德而武傷百姓，百姓弗堪。
units.en: Under Jie, lords had rebelled since Kongjia's day; Jie cultivated force, not virtue, until the people could bear no more.
units.literal: Emperor Jie's time, from Kongjia onward many lords rebelled Xia, Jie not pursuing virtue but martially injuring hundred surnames, hundred surnames not endure.

units.zh: 乃召湯而囚之夏臺，已而釋之。
units.en: He summoned Tang, jailed him in the Xia tower, then let him go.
units.literal: Then summoned Tang and imprisoned him at Xia tower, afterward released him.

units.zh: 湯修德，諸侯皆歸湯，湯遂率兵以伐夏桀。
units.en: Tang built up his virtue until the lords rallied to him, then led an army against Jie.
units.literal: Tang cultivated virtue, lords all returned Tang, Tang thereupon led troops to attack Xia Jie.

units.zh: 桀走鳴條，遂放而死。
units.en: Jie fled to Mingtiao, was driven out, and died.
units.literal: Jie fled Mingtiao, thereupon banished then died.

units.zh: 桀謂人曰：「吾悔不遂殺湯於夏臺，使至此。」
units.en: Jie said to those about him, "I rue not killing Tang in the Xia tower when I could—now I am brought to this pass."
units.literal: Jie told people saying, "I regret not then killing Tang at Xia tower, causing arrive here."

units.zh: 湯乃踐天子位，代夏朝天下。
units.en: Tang then took the throne in Xia's place and faced the realm as Son of Heaven.
units.literal: Tang thereupon trod Son of Heaven position, replacing Xia facing all under Heaven.

units.zh: 湯封夏之後，至周封於杞也。
units.en: Tang enfeoffed Xia's descendants; by Zhou times they held the state of Qi.
units.literal: Tang enfeoffed Xia's posterity, reaching Zhou enfeoffed at Qi.

units.zh: 太史公曰：禹為姒姓，其後分封，用國為姓，故有夏后氏、有扈氏、有男氏、斟尋氏、彤城氏、褒氏、費 氏、杞氏、繒氏、辛氏、冥氏、斟（氏）戈氏。
units.en: The Grand Historian says: Yu bore the surname Si; later branches took their states as clan names, producing houses such as Xiahou, Youhu, Younan, Zhenxun, Tongcheng, Bao, Fei, Qi, Zeng, Xin, Ming, Zhen, and Ge.
units.literal: The Grand Historian says: Yu was of the Si surname; his descendants were enfeoffed separately and took their states as surnames, hence there were the Xiahou, Youhu, Younan, Zhenxun, Tongcheng, Bao, Fei, Qi, Zeng, Xin, Ming, Zhen, and Ge clans.

units.zh: 孔子正夏時，學者多傳夏小正云。
units.en: Confucius set the Xia calendar straight, and scholars still pass down the Xia minor calendar.
units.literal: Confucius corrected Xia calendar, scholars many transmit Xia minor calendar saying.

units.zh: 自虞、夏時，貢賦備矣。
units.en: From the age of Yu and Xia the tribute system was already full-formed.
units.literal: From Yu and Xia time, tribute levies already complete.

units.zh: 或言禹會諸侯江南，計功而崩，因葬焉，命曰會稽。
units.en: Some hold that Yu met the lords south of the Yangtze, settled the tally of merits, and died there—hence the name Kuaiji, "gathering of tallies."
units.literal: Some say Yu assembled the lords south of the Yangtze, reckoned merit and died, and was buried there; it was named Kuaiji.

units.zh: 會稽者，會計也。
units.en: Kuaiji means reckoning.
units.literal: Kuaiji means reckoning.
